title: JANUS Linear A SigLA full-universe parser-integrity preflight
purpose: Validate the machine-facing SigLA word parser over the already frozen 686-document identity universe before any R3A_4 positional/semantic scoring is allowed.

derivation_history.exploratory_basis: The rules below were motivated by the already frozen 32-document structural capability artifact and three-document word-view artifact. Their prevalence is NOT claimed from those discovery samples; universality/readiness is evaluated only by this frozen full-universe validation.

scientific_machine_sequence_anchor_parse.capture_rule: Capture the exact non-empty character sequence between literal marker 'word-match @ !seq-pattern:' and the next literal '//'.
scientific_machine_sequence_anchor_parse.per_document_sequence_payload_receipt: Store only SHA256 over the JSON serialization of the exact captured sequence list in DOM anchor order; do not persist the raw list in this preflight result.

source_native_structural_cross_checks.zero_word_rule: If reported_word_count == 0, seq-pattern anchor count must be 0 and there must be 0 popup span.word nodes and 0 SVG a.word reference nodes.
source_native_structural_cross_checks.positive_word_rule: If reported_word_count == N > 0, seq-pattern anchor count must equal N, popup span.word count must equal N, SVG a.word reference count must equal N, and strict ordinal relation word-0..word-(N-1) ↔ index-word-0.html..index-word-(N-1).html must hold in DOM order.

readiness_gate_inherited_from_frozen_R3A.additional_integrity_requirement: Among evaluable documents, every document must be PASS_ZERO_WORD or PASS_POSITIVE_WORD; any deterministic parser/structure mismatch blocks scoring rather than lowering thresholds.

forbidden: do not compute INITIAL/FINAL role statistics
do not compute candidate recurrence or significance
do not reveal known glosses or Linear B readings
do not access mwenge transcription content
do not repair malformed seq-pattern or ordinal syntax
do not change the already frozen R3A_4 scientific thresholds
do not call this external transcription replication or decipherment
success_gate: The frozen database.js hash is exact; the complete 686-document bridge universe is attempted without replacement; at least 400 documents and at least 80% of 686 are evaluable; and every evaluable document satisfies the frozen zero-word or positive-word integrity rule with zero deterministic parser/structure mismatches.
next_if_pass: Issue a parser-integrity admission receipt that permits, but does not itself execute, the already frozen R3A_4 SigLA-native blind role discovery.
next_if_fail: Block R3A_4 scoring and preserve exact mismatch/failure taxonomy; correct the parser in a separately versioned gate without weakening scientific thresholds.
